answer_2.quote: we propose a comprehensive evaluation metric applicable to both human-created and AI-generated explanatory videos... Our metric evaluates videos across five key dimensions... In our metric implementation, Accuracy & Depth and Logical Flow are assessed using text-based evaluation... For Visual Relevance and Element Layout, we apply image processing techniques... and use GPT-4o to assign scores... To evaluate motions in Visual Consistency, we utilize Gemini 2.0-Flash...

answer_3.quote: For Visual Relevance and Element Layout, we apply image processing techniques to identify key frames and use GPT-4o to assign scores for each dimension. To evaluate motions in Visual Consistency, we utilize Gemini 2.0-Flash to analyze chunked video segments.
methods: LLM scoring of key frames and video segments

answer_4.quote: To validate the effectiveness of our evaluation metrics, we conducted a small-scale human study. We sampled 40 videos... recruited 12 experienced STEM student annotators... The rating process followed the same five evaluation dimensions as our proposed metrics... To complement our automated metrics, we conducted a human evaluation study. 18 annotators were asked to rank videos...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators scored videos on five dimensions using a scale of [0, 0.5, 1], with guiding questions for each dimension; in the preference study, videos were ranked based on clarity and visual appeal.
